narration: A lock that can't be picked. Meet RuneWorks, from the alchemy industry on Meme Street's fictional market. It makes locks sealed with alchemical runes, that no tool can open. It earns from selling locks, vault contracts with banks and museums, and key services like re-keying and recovery. Its customers include banks, museums, and homes. Security you can actually trust. Its edge is rune recipes that nobody else knows. The risks? One broken lock would hurt its reputation, GoldMaker Labs is the other big name in alchemy, and home sales are slow.
